decisions.evidence: Checker exception is business validation of out-of-range sales price during price input; generated exception is a database availability failure (connection failure/database down) during an unrelated 'Read or update Category records' operation. Trigger and failure mechanism are incompatible.
Checker is a price-range validation exception for sales price; generated is a concurrency conflict/lost update during Category record persistence. Different trigger and behavior.

Generated exception concerns field legality (type error, illegal characters, over length) for Category records, while checker concerns sales price exceeding allowed numerical range. Different validation target and failure condition.
Checker covers price-range validation; generated covers idempotency (duplicate requests causing duplicate operations). No shared condition or behavior.
Generated is a persistence failure (write failure/transaction rollback) for Category records; checker is a validation failure for sales price range. Different failure mechanism.
Generated is query performance timeout on large joins; checker is sales price range validation. No shared trigger or behavior.
Generated concerns referential integrity (cascade delete failure or orphaned child objects); checker concerns sales price range validation. Different trigger and operation.
Generated concerns missing required fields for Category records; checker concerns out-of-range sales price. Different validation target and failure condition.
